objective: Complete the from-scratch 2x2 V/c_proj factorial on the selected QK-only attention replacement, then admit at most one c_proj fixed-chart capacity intervention without a learned dense basis or additive adapter.

factorial_metrics.identity_check: v_shapley + cproj_shapley == L11 - L00 at every fixed evaluation

capacity_derivation.evidence: The deployed BlockFHT c_proj tangent is an exact tight frame and captures approximately its one-percent random coordinate share, with no enrichment over equal-rank Haar. A single ten-percent ratio tests a tenfold fixed-chart capacity increase directly; no intermediate or post-hoc ratio sweep is authorized.

decision.authorize_cproj_ratio10_if: At terminal, cproj_shapley is positive and at least 0.05 CE, or positive V-by-c_proj interaction is at least 0.03 CE. The same sign must hold at at least three of four fixed evaluations.
decision.otherwise: Reject c_proj capacity as the immediate branch. If V dominates, isolate V structure; if neither main effect dominates but interaction is negative or small, retain the QK+V/dense-c_proj partial architecture as the evidence-backed fallback and do not launch a capacity run.
decision.training_gate: After authorization only: generate the immutable config, run an exact-config synchronous MFU preflight, require MFU >= 20% and finite losses, then launch with one verified persistent aggregate watchdog. Runs longer than five minutes are never foreground-polled.
decision.promotion: Relative to the exact QK+c_proj/dense-V parent, require at least 0.02 CE improvement at terminal without worsening more than one earlier fixed evaluation by over 0.01 CE before transferring c_proj ratio 0.10 into the full QK+V+c_proj model.

parameter_accounting.note: Counts instantiate GPTConfig with block_fht=true. They include Cayley coordinates and all trainable attention tensors. The QK+V/dense-c_proj fallback reduces trainable attention parameters by about 59.6%, not the paper's whole-model 200-500x claim.
